Larry David discovers his German heritage by way of ancestors who settled in Mobile, Alabama in the mid-19th century — including one who became a slaveholding Confederate; Bernie Sanders gains greater understanding of his father’s dangerous childhood in Austrian Galicia during World War I. Both guests discover what happened to the family members who were still in Europe during the Holocaust — Larry David’s grandfather lost nine siblings; Bernie Sanders’ uncle, a member of the Limanowa Judenrat, heroically went head to head with a Nazi officer. programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Former couple Sara and Jackson board a single-engine plane for a routine and casual flight to their friend's tropical island wedding. However, within minutes after takeoff, their pilot suffers a fatal heart attack, leaving them with no idea where they are, and no clue how to land the plane. With nothing but miles of ocean and sky in every direction, and a terrifying storm that's about to envelop them, Sara and Jackson have only one shot -- and there's no going back.

programme.title: Battle: Los Angeles
programme.desc: For many years, humans have reported various UFO sightings around the world, fueling speculation about the existence of life on other worlds. In 2011, mankind learns the truth the hard way when alien invaders attack. One by one, the world's great cities fall, leaving Los Angeles as the battleground for humanity's last stand. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Struggling new attorney Rudy Baylor (Matt Damon) resorts to working for a shady lawyer (Mickey Rourke), where he meets paralegal Deck Shifflet (Danny DeVito). When the insurance company of Dot Black (Mary Kay Place) refuses her dying son coverage, Baylor and Shifflet team up to fight the corrupt corporation, taking on its callous lawyer (Jon Voight). Meanwhile, Baylor becomes involved with Kelly Riker (Claire Danes), an abused wife, whose husband complicates matters when he confronts Baylor.

programme.title: A Mighty Heart
programme.desc: Mariane Pearl (Angelina Jolie), the wife of journalist Daniel Pearl (Dan Futterman) of The Wall Street Journal, heads to Pakistan after terrorists capture her husband. In the terrifying weeks that follow, she must cope with international attention and find her way through the dangerous world of underground politics in a desperate effort to find him.

programme.title: The Best of Me
programme.desc: Amanda and Dawson, who were once high-school sweethearts, have a bittersweet reunion when they return to their hometown for the funeral of a mutual friend. Seeing each other again after 20 years apart reignites the love they've never forgotten, but Amanda and Dawson soon discover that the forces that drove them apart when they were younger pose even more threats today.

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan.

Taj, however, offers Koverchenko sanctuary for his assistance against the unit.

programme.desc: In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana In the first episode, Martyna will visit India.The main character of the program will be Jyoti Amge, who is 21 years old and only 63 centimeters tall.She is a real record holder, proclaimed the smallest woman in the world.Her height hasn't changed much since birth.The girl's parents tried to help her - to no avail.Indian doctors diagnosed Jyoti with growth hormone deficiency and achondroplasia - a genetic disease that is associated with disorders in the structure and development of bones, as well as with dwarfism.Jyoti's bones are weak, brittle, some permanently damaged.The girl will show Martyna what everyday life looks like from her perspective.He will also talk about obstacles and fulfilling his dreams of a career in Hollywood.She has already performed, among others,in the series "American Horror Story", alongside Jessica Lang.

programme.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programme.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world

programme.desc: In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana The Philippines is the most Catholic country in Asia.Nine out of ten people here profess faith in Jesus.Good Friday crucifixions attract crowds of spectators.Filipinos participate in them with their entire families.Every year, several dozen people are crucified and hundreds are scourged.The bloody ritual is a testimony of faith and an act of penance.However, the Church in the Philippines does not support him.Near Manila, in the province of Bulacan, Martyna meets 47-year-old Precy Valencia, who works as a seamstress.He has two children and grandchildren.This seemingly ordinary woman submits herself to crucifixion every year on Good Friday.Her greatest support is her loving husband - Celestino.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: A three-day UFO festival takes place every year in a small town in Pennsylvania, attracting extraterrestrial civilization enthusiasts from all over America.This place is not accidental, because most reports of encounters with aliens are reported in this area.Although interest in UFOs appears to be waning in favor of technology and artificial intelligence threats, extraterrestrial enthusiasts remain active.They organize and write petitions to the government asking for the disclosure of secret files.Although UFOs are most often associated with Roswell and Area 51, the center of this phenomenon is currently located in a provincial town near Pittsburgh and in Washington state.Marcin Prokop intends to meet with UFO enthusiasts and researchers to assess the evidence for the existence of cryptids and extraterrestrial civilizations.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programme.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programme.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.
